candidate_context_rule: evaluate only contexts with at least two v21 supported processes
pair_manifest_rule: derive mechanically from authoritative v21 context_decisions.csv; never hand-edit pair membership

pairwise_rule.description: Within each frozen target context, leave one non-target source block out of training at a time. Compare Q-only knockout against P+Q knockout to estimate P conditional contribution, and P-only knockout against P+Q knockout for Q. Frozen ModelSpecs are averaged within each source perturbation; source perturbations are the uncertainty units.

primary_development_readout: false seasonality demotion among co-supported contexts
pairwise directional accuracy against known truth
